Round 55 result: **BLOCKED (environment)**. The code fix checks out offline. None of the browser checks could run, for the fourth round in a row: the Store dev server (`http://127.0.0.1:5173/studio-lab`) and the backend (`:5199`) returned `000` at 19:55, 20:04 and 20:06 +04. I did not start them.

That means the stageΓÇæ4a browser checks and G55ΓÇæ3 have not run in four rounds, so this round cannot pass. G55ΓÇæ3 is the check that an anonymous visitor to `/studio-lab` doesn't get past the premium sign-in. Nothing that plays real audio or video, or exports a WAV, was measured either.

**Passed (re-run myself, not taken from A's report):**
- **G55ΓÇæ2:** HEAD is `038ed5a`, the same 17 changed paths at start and end, all 410 frozen files match, and the 4 protected files are unchanged.
- **R55ΓÇæS:** the source change is one hunk at the Shift branch in `ArrangementClip.tsx`. The tests are a pure append (CM9cΓÇôCM9e) and the doc only got its status line and a new section. All three files use LF line endings, and there is no banned content.
- **R55ΓÇæU:** I wrote my own versions of mutations (a), (b) and (c). Each failed exactly the tests it should: CM9c/d/e, CM9e only, and CM9c/d. Mutation (a) also reproduces A's red run.
  - In jsdom probes, a clip starting at 6.0004 now keeps that start when Shift-dragged to another lane, whether a neighbour touches it (PSΓÇæTOUCH) or the lane is empty (PSΓÇæFREE).
  - A Shift drag on the same lane (PSΓÇæSAME) changes nothing and adds no Undo entry. The roundΓÇæ54 version of the file still shows both bugs, so the probes do tell the two apart.
  - The Shift ghost is drawn at exactly 6.0004 (240.016 px), and group moves are unaffected.
- **G55ΓÇæ1:** typecheck 0, 87 files / 1504 tests passing, build OK, `npm run verify` passed first try, Biome at the baseline of 5/218/1. The load timeouts (CΓÇæR48ΓÇæ01) didn't happen this time, but one clean run doesn't close that bug.

**Findings for B** (both info level; neither was caused by this round):
- **INFOΓÇæR55ΓÇæFREEΓÇæROUNDΓÇæUNGUARDED:** B rejected one alternative fix (dropping the ms rounding when Snap is off) because it would let pixel noise into clip starts. No test covers that rounding: removing it on the old file also fixes the bug and all 170 tests stay green. One guarding test would cover it.
- **INFOΓÇæR55ΓÇæREFUSALΓÇæSTATUSΓÇæONΓÇæRELEASE:** when you release a cross-lane move that was refused, the status bar shows the generic "no change" text. The refusal reason shown during the drag is lost. This already happened before round 55, for whole-ms starts too.

B's suggested group probe (PSΓÇæGROUP) doesn't actually test anything: the move is refused because the second clip is already on the last lane, so the starts stay the same in either version. I used a second fixture (PSΓÇæGROUP-B) that does.

**For root:** the round 50ΓÇô55 change has no open defect from me. CΓÇæR54ΓÇæ01/02 are fixed at unit and probe level, and CΓÇæR53ΓÇæ01 only at unit level. There is no browser evidence yet, so committing on that basis is your call. Please start the Store dev server and the backend before the next verification so the browser checks and G55ΓÇæ3 can run.

I've also listed the items carried from `root-pre-push-review.md` and `publication-checkpoint.json` (video sync failures, the purchased loader hardcoding `middle-east`, portable paths, the scrollbar request) in the report as unchanged.
